english.title: At slaughterhouse, fail to ensure animal bled or pithed without delay after being simple stunned
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) at **(..SPECIFY SLAUGHTERHOUSE..),

(A)_[being a person engaged in the bleeding or pithing of an animal which had been simple stunned, failed]_
(B)_[caused a person engaged in the bleeding or pithing of an animal which had been simple stunned to fail]_
(B)_[permitted a person engaged in the bleeding or pithing of an animal which had been simple stunned to fail]_

to ensure that the animal was bled or pithed without delay after it had been simple stunned
english.legislation: Contrary to regulations 30(1)(c) and 33(1) of, and paragraph 31(1) of Schedule 1 to, the Welfare of Animals at the Time of Killing (England) Regulations 2015.

other.penalty:
Summary: Fine

Time limit for prosecutions
6 monthsNote
Note that for offences committed since 12 March 2015, section 85 of the Legal Aid, Sentencing and Punishment of Offenders Act 2012 removes the limits on certain fines given by the Magistrates' Courts. Offences that were previously punishable by fines of 'prescribed sums' and that were limited to 'not exceeding level 5 on the standard scale' or 'not exceeding the statutory maximum', are now punishable by a fine of any amount.
